p1.title: Semantic fallback lacks critical product parity
p1.narrative: The weak-device world-in-words path omits full sponsor, Chronicle, and contextual-selection behavior and still exposes raw internal enumeration labels.

p1.title: Default town view lacks inhabited-world presence
p1.narrative: The initial settlement is too dispersed, residents and tasks are too small, and mobile hides most activity, so the world is not visually convincing at first inspection.

p1.title: Important controls miss touch target budget
p1.narrative: Several buttons and summaries measure between 40.8 and 42.4 CSS pixels high instead of meeting the provisional 44-pixel target.
